answers.question: List all song names by singers above the average age.
answers.generated_answer: select song_name from singer join singer_in_concert on singer_singer_id = singer_id join concert on concert_id = concert_concert_id where age > (select avg ( age ) from singer)>>

answers.question: What are the ids of the students who do not own cats as pets?
answers.generated_answer: select stuid from student where stuid not in ( select stuid from has_pet join pets on has_pet_petid = pets_petid where pettype = 'cat' )>>
